newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: The Warehouse shoots ahead after result.
newsitem.headline: The Warehouse shoots ahead after result.

text.p: Shares in retail chain The Warehouse Group Limited shot up 45 cents to NZ$3.65 on Thursday morning after it posted a better than expected half-year result result after Wednesday's close.
"The result was well above expectations," said BZW's head of research John McMahon. "Most people were positively surprised."
Doyle Paterson Brown broker Paul Davenport agreed the result was a positive surprise to most.
He said his firm was at the top of market expectations at around $20 million dollars, while the six month profit actually came in at $25.3 million.
He said there had been lingering concern about the company's inventory system problems which hit Warehouse hard last year but it was obvious from the result that the issue was now behind it.
The company's margins were robust during a difficult retailing period while its distribution system appeared to be operating well and costs had been cut, he added.
The Warehouse said it expected its operating profit in the second half year to be "considerably less" than that of the first six months to January 31, but due to seasonal factors.
Beyond that it said it was confident of achieving "a sound financial result" for the full year.
